reviewNotes.note: सीधा / सिधा remains a reference spelling question for native-speaker review. The nasal mark in यहाँबाट is now preserved; original strict references are unchanged.

Reference मिठो differs from returned मीठो. This may be a reference spelling issue rather than an engine defect. Original labels and strict counts are retained; seek native-speaker review before treating these as wrong suggestions.
खुसी / खुशी is a spelling-variant question. Strict original reference agreement is recorded; it does not establish that the alternate is invalid.

policies.sentencePolicy: Automatic first-choice acceptance. NFC exact whole-text agreement; spacing, punctuation and numeral script count. Only references listed before capture are accepted.
policies.choicePolicy: Actual word list after explicit Nepali left context; first/top-five/reference reciprocal rank. Prefix traces are observations, not completion-accuracy scores.
policies.workflowPolicy: Fresh browser state for every workflow. Final reference and all intermediate checkpoints must match. Missing choices, exceptions and page errors fail the case. Reload may request local static assets; typing remains offline.
